original_ubuntu_full_receipt.limits: Two development seeds, two novel hand-specified binary causal-family pairs. All policies have matched interventions/observed outcomes per episode and common exogenous noise; decisions choose distinct actions so samples are not identical action IDs. Evaluation is same exhaustive counterfactual EXPECTED-Brier grid, not a hidden reward or any training event. Extra policy and examiner compute is NOT matched. No real-world general intelligence, unfamiliar action semantics, owner held first-use, native runtime merge, full regression or deployment.

interpretation.positive: Closed-loop interventions genuinely changed the data the native and causal models learned. Candidate chose different actions from exact IG on 20.905% and 21.659% of decisions. On second DEV seed candidate expected Brier 0.142423 versus exact IG 0.146941 and all other sampled controls worse, and had better late A-return than exact IG by about 0.009976.
interpretation.negative: On first DEV seed exact IG (0.140683) exceeded IPFC (0.144036) on pooled late, and candidate native Brier 0.147272 was worse than exact IG native 0.138595. On second DEV seed the candidate's pooled gain vs strongest exact IG 0.004517 failed the fixed 0.010 margin. The first seed late return IPFC was 0.129745 vs IG 0.128044, and second seed early return IPFC 0.209457 vs IG 0.196506 (worse by 0.012951, outside +0.010). No two-seed consistent dominance.
interpretation.control_significance: Exact causal Bayesian information-gain is a separately source-trained same-grammar policy using a mathematically exact entropy objective for the known Bernoulli noise. The advantage is NOT demonstrated above this strong control, despite gains over random, coverage, Beta-IG and fixed-zero.
interpretation.representation_boundary: Both causal worlds used binary hand-specified structural functions different from CKAD39. They do not test unfamiliar action-symbol semantics, broad causal world transfer, or grounding from real-world experiences. Neither native accepted model nor a novel unbounded intelligence architecture was changed.
interpretation.test_structure: Common source-noise streams and equal action budgets plus common untrained exhaustive probes prevent spurious on-policy easy-observation scoring. Extra action-planning compute not equalized, so no efficiency claims.

authority_and_limits: Research-only source-trained CKAD42 exact and original NativeEpisodeExperience in a sidecar; Yggdrasil accepted main unchanged.
The two registered DEV seeds are now consumed; no new tuning/replay on them, and reserved pilots/primary held untouched.

PASS denotes GitHub Actions fixture-development and 2-OS source custody only. Scientific DEV_NO_GO prohibits promotion; no full final regression, first-use owner/independent scientific qualification, or deployment.
